lib/tenancy/tenant-records.ts.reason: The tenant tree's record checks (S5 B5b). Each reads a record's tenant_id by slug or token for a signed-out visitor, before any page renders, and compares it to the tenant from the URL param. It runs only under app/%5Ft, so nothing reaches it with TENANT_ROUTING_ENABLED off. A tenantDb client can't be used yet: the check is what decides the record is this tenant's, and TENANT_DB_ENABLED is off.
